items.title: Fortive (FTV) Ties Accruent To PowerX For AI Telecom Energy Management
items.summary: Accruent, a Fortive (NYSE:FTV) operating company, has entered into a partnership with PowerX to integrate AI-driven energy management into telecom infrastructure. The collaboration will bring PowerX capabilities into Accruent’s Siterra platform, targeting more efficient energy use and cost control for telecom sites.
